title: Ramón de Cardona, viceroy of Naples, to Charles I, Naples 5 Oct 1517 and 18 Jun 1520, BNE MSS/20210/11/1 and /4 (catalogue 854)

steps.what: BNE Digital scans viewed (the BDH viewer had returned 403); /1 and /4 carry cipher, /2 and /3 are clear.
Four blocks transcribed (80 lines, 1,663 tokens), labels later checked on the images (L o, E O, z, p, O, d#, E/ε).
vich1511, vich1515 and Lannoy's key (Kolosova 2017) compared: same family, different table; Lannoy's letter values decode barely above chance (z = +1.2 against shuffles).
Own letter and stream solvers; a control on vich1511 N.60 showed the objective preferred wrong keys.

vich1515 joint annealer (wsa4) with matched (99-100% of signs at 10M iterations) and noisy controls (best runs 90%); on Cardona the runs never agreed beyond about 75% of signs, also with fixed values, cribs and three tokenisation variants.
wsa5: class rule from Lannoy's key (same initial+final = same first letter) and an option list of whole words only. Top 6 runs agree on 85-94% of sign tokens; 35 of 63 sign types 6/6.
Chancery model without Quijote (Celestina, Villa's Memorias, vich1511 clear letters), 34 signs fixed: frequent code groups agree (que, de, en, lo, se, el papa ...).
Rounds 2-5 (firm values fixed, rest re-annealed) alternating with reading by context; E/EO/ε/o+ settled on the images; Borghese Petrucci (1517) and Giampaolo Baglioni (1520) confirm the key.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1517 tokens, 132 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -1.956 per letter; random keys -3.403 (z 8.9); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.366 (mean -2.402, z 17.7); annealer on the real text -2.199. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.956; polyphony 0.0; 119 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.199

outcome.method_basis: Sign alphabet recovered without a crib by the joint annealer of vich1515 extended with Lannoy's class rule and whole-word code options; code groups by a chancery model and context; a final context pass overruled two unanimous sign values (A ll, ll e). Confirmed by two historical names (Borghese Petrucci, Giampaolo Baglioni). No external plaintext used.

gaps.item: 22 code types without a value and 12 doubtful (most once or twice; commonest open: gie 3 tokens; probably names: 'las cosas de nac y feg'; doubtful gnd 'mes' reads in neither context)
gaps.detail: BRAH 9/15 ff. 1-6 (DECODE R9815-R9820) is the candidate key; its images need DECODE access

gaps.item: rare signs = c# 7+ S ^L# (1-7 tokens); o+ possibly two shapes
gaps.detail: 1,070 px images; small signs hard to separate

gaps.item: garbled runs A09, C18, D07; fax read esto (C16) or cardenales (D03, A11)
gaps.detail: the published scan (about 1,070 px) is the largest available; recheck on a better image from the BNE

outcome.notes: Status report #262 and update; decoded, not read: long passages read but most sentences have holes.

credits.note: transcription, key recovered ciphertext-only (with Claude Code / Claude Opus 5.5), reading by context

texts.label: block A, 5 Oct 1517 (22 lines)
texts.summary: Troops and Rome: news reported from Rome, Gaeta, the cost and the discharge of fifty men (lances?).

texts.label: block B, 5 Oct 1517 (11 lines)
texts.summary: The troops cannot be kept or paid; the impossibility of it; a prison emptied.

texts.label: block C, 5 Oct 1517 (28 lines)
texts.summary: No money to keep the infantry; the Pope; Borghese Petrucci, brother of the executed cardinal, wishes to live and die under the Pope's protection.

texts.label: block D, 18 Jun 1520 (19 lines)
texts.summary: Proceedings and sentence in Rome after the beheading of Giampaolo Baglioni ('[Io]han Paulo Ballón'); a Neapolitan parlamento; the pay.

outcome.fraction_read_source: decryption/reading.md (draft 4) against decryption/decode.txt: 2,162 letters read as sense (doubtful words and holes excluded) of about 2,890 plaintext letters (decoded letters plus unread code tokens at about 5 letters); docs/_check_reading.py clean sentence share 0.486.

human: Michael Brackx chose the target and the leads to pursue, solved the BNE and Google Books CAPTCHAs, downloaded the Kolosova thesis, and asked for the controls; the joint annealer is his (vich1515).
